residual.name: Axeyum.Autogenesis.intFibNatAbsResidualV2
residual.statement_shape: for arbitrary fibFn : Int -> Int and natFib : Nat -> Nat, positive presentation plus modulo-two negative-even/negative-odd presentations imply natAbs (fibFn m) = natFib (natAbs m)
explicit_parameters: positivePresentation : forall n, fibFn (Int.ofNat n) = Int.ofNat (natFib n)
negativeEven : forall n, n % 2 = 0 -> fibFn (-(Int.ofNat n)) = -Int.ofNat (natFib n)
negativeOdd : forall n, n % 2 = 1 -> fibFn (-(Int.ofNat n)) = Int.ofNat (natFib n)
modCases : forall n, n % 2 = 0 or n % 2 = 1
residual.proof_route: direct Int constructor cases; positive presentation in ofNat; clean modCases with negativeEven or negativeOdd in negSucc; no proposition-level conditional

next_on_accept: freeze exact specialization over the already sealed positive, negative-even, negative-odd, modCases, and natAbs support roots
